关键词: Iran Threat Reduction and Syria Human Rights Act of 2012 (ITRSHRA)
Comprehensive Iran Sanctions, Accountability, and Divestment Act of 2010 (CISADA)
主要内容: The U.S. Department of the Treasury submitted a report to Congress on September 24, 2012, under the Iran Threat Reduction and Syria Human Rights Act of 2012 (ITRSHRA). The report determined that the National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) is an agent or affiliate of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). The report also noted that there is insufficient information to determine whether the National Iranian Tanker Company (NITC) is an agent or affiliate of the IRGC. The IRGC is described as Iran’s most powerful economic actor, dominating sectors such as energy, construction, and banking. The IRGC has been sanctioned for activities related to Iran’s nuclear program, support for terrorism, and human rights abuses. The report highlights the IRGC’s efforts to evade sanctions by selling Iranian oil and its growing influence within NIOC, including the appointment of Rostam Qasemi, a Brigadier General in the IRGC, as Minister of Petroleum. As a result of the determination, NIOC is now classified as an agent or affiliate of the IRGC under the Comprehensive Iran Sanctions, Accountability, and Divestment Act of 2010 (CISADA).
